lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak kee prabh benatee prabh milahu paraapat hoi ||
lines.translation: Nanak makes this prayer to God: "Please, come and unite me with Yourself."

lines.gurmukhi: ਵੈਸਾਖੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ ਤਾਂ ਲਗੈ ਜਾ ਸੰਤੁ ਭੇਟੈ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: vaisaakh suhaavaa taa(n) lagai jaa sa(n)t bhetai har soi ||3||
lines.translation: The month of Vaisaakh is beautiful and pleasant, when the Saint causes me to meet the Lord. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੇਠਿ ਜੁੜੰਦਾ ਲੋੜੀਐ ਜਿਸੁ ਅਗੈ ਸਭਿ ਨਿਵੰਨਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: har jeth juRa(n)daa loReeai jis agai sabh niva(n)n ||
lines.translation: In the month of Jayt'h, the bride longs to meet with the Lord. All bow in humility before Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਜਣ ਦਾਵਣਿ ਲਗਿਆ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਦੇਈ ਬੰਨਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: har sajan daavan lagiaa kisai na deee ba(n)n ||
lines.translation: One who has grasped the hem of the robe of the Lord, the True Friend-no one can keep him in bondage.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਣਕ ਮੋਤੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਉਨ ਲਗੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਸੰਨਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: maanak motee naam prabh un lagai naahee sa(n)n ||
lines.translation: God's Name is the Jewel, the Pearl. It cannot be stolen or taken away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੰਗ ਸਭੇ ਨਾਰਾਇਣੈ ਜੇਤੇ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੰਨਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ra(n)g sabhe naaraainai jete man bhaava(n)n ||
lines.translation: In the Lord are all pleasures which please the mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਲੋੜੇ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਸੋਈ ਜੀਅ ਕਰੰਨਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo har loRe so kare soee jee kara(n)n ||
lines.translation: As the Lord wishes, so He acts, and so His creatures act.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕੀਤੇ ਆਪਣੇ ਸੇਈ ਕਹੀਅਹਿ ਧੰਨਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo prabh keete aapane seee kaheeahi dha(n)n ||
lines.translation: They alone are called blessed, whom God has made His Own.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਣ ਲੀਆ ਜੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਿਛੁੜਿ ਕਿਉ ਰੋਵੰਨਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: aapan leeaa je milai vichhuR kiu rova(n)n ||
lines.translation: If people could meet the Lord by their own efforts, why would they be crying out in the pain of separation?

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗੁ ਪਰਾਪਤੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਣੰਨਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: saadhoo sa(n)g paraapate naanak ra(n)g maana(n)n ||
lines.translation: Meeting Him in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, O Nanak, celestial bliss is enjoyed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੇਠੁ ਰੰਗੀਲਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਧਣੀ ਜਿਸ ਕੈ ਭਾਗੁ ਮਥੰਨਿ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: har jeth ra(n)geelaa tis dhanee jis kai bhaag matha(n)n ||4||
lines.translation: In the month of Jayt'h, the playful Husband Lord meets her, upon whose forehead such good destiny is recorded. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾੜੁ ਤਪੰਦਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਲਗੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਹੁ ਨ ਜਿੰਨਾ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaaR tapa(n)daa tis lagai har naahu na ji(n)naa paas ||
lines.translation: The month of Aasaarh seems burning hot, to those who are not close to their Husband Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਕੈ ਮਾਣਸ ਸੰਦੀ ਆਸ ॥
lines.transliteration: jagajeevan purakh tiaag kai maanas sa(n)dee aas ||
lines.translation: They have forsaken God the Primal Being, the Life of the World, and they have come to rely upon mere mortals.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਯੈ ਭਾਇ ਵਿਗੁਚੀਐ ਗਲਿ ਪਈਸੁ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸ ॥
lines.transliteration: duyai bhaai vigucheeai gal paees jam kee phaas ||
lines.translation: In the love of duality, the soul-bride is ruined; around her neck she wears the noose of Death.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇਹਾ ਬੀਜੈ ਸੋ ਲੁਣੈ ਮਥੈ ਜੋ ਲਿਖਿਆਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jehaa beejai so lunai mathai jo likhiaas ||
lines.translation: As you plant, so shall you harvest; your destiny is recorded on your forehead.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਣੀ ਪਛੁਤਾਣੀ ਉਠਿ ਚਲੀ ਗਈ ਨਿਰਾਸ ॥
lines.transliteration: rain vihaanee pachhutaanee uth chalee gaee niraas ||
lines.translation: The life-night passes away, and in the end, one comes to regret and repent, and then depart with no hope at all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕੌ ਸਾਧੂ ਭੇਟੀਐ ਸੋ ਦਰਗਹ ਹੋਇ ਖਲਾਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin kau saadhoo bheteeai so daragah hoi khalaas ||
lines.translation: Those who meet with the Holy Saints are liberated in the Court of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਪਣੀ ਤੇਰੇ ਦਰਸਨ ਹੋਇ ਪਿਆਸ ॥
lines.transliteration: kar kirapaa prabh aapanee tere darasan hoi piaas ||
lines.translation: Show Your Mercy to me, O God; I am thirsty for the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: prabh tudh bin doojaa ko nahee naanak kee aradaas ||
lines.translation: Without You, God, there is no other at all. This is Nanak's humble prayer.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾੜੁ ਸੁਹੰਦਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਲਗੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਨਿਵਾਸ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: aasaaR suha(n)daa tis lagai jis man har charan nivaas ||5||
lines.translation: The month of Aasaarh is pleasant, when the Feet of the Lord abide in the mind. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਵਣਿ ਸਰਸੀ ਕਾਮਣੀ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸਿਉ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: saavan sarasee kaamanee charan kamal siu piaar ||
lines.translation: In the month of Saawan, the soul-bride is happy, if she falls in love with the Lotus Feet of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਰਤਾ ਸਚ ਰੰਗਿ ਇਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: man tan rataa sach ra(n)g iko naam adhaar ||
lines.translation: Her mind and body are imbued with the Love of the True One; His Name is her only Support.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਖਿਆ ਰੰਗ ਕੂੜਾਵਿਆ ਦਿਸਨਿ ਸਭੇ ਛਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: bikhiaa ra(n)g kooRaaviaa disan sabhe chhaar ||
lines.translation: The pleasures of corruption are false. All that is seen shall turn to ashes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬੂੰਦ ਸੁਹਾਵਣੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਪੀਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: har a(n)mrit boo(n)d suhaavanee mil saadhoo peevanahaar ||
lines.translation: The drops of the Lord's Nectar are so beautiful! Meeting the Holy Saint, we drink these in.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਣੁ ਤਿਣੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਉਲਿਆ ਸੰਮ੍ਰਥ ਪੁਰਖ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: van tin prabh sa(n)g mauliaa sa(n)mrath purakh apaar ||
lines.translation: The forests and the meadows are rejuvenated and refreshed with the Love of God, the All-powerful, Infinite Primal Being.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲਣੈ ਨੋ ਮਨੁ ਲੋਚਦਾ ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: har milanai no man lochadaa karam milaavanahaar ||
lines.translation: My mind yearns to meet the Lord. If only He would show His Mercy, and unite me with Himself!

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਸਖੀਏ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹੰਉ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: jinee sakheee prabh paaiaa ha(n)u tin kai sad balihaar ||
lines.translation: Those brides who have obtained God-I am forever a sacrifice to them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਜੀ ਮਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak har jee maiaa kar sabad savaaranahaar ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, when the Dear Lord shows kindness, He adorns His bride with the Word of His Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਵਣੁ ਤਿਨਾ ਸੁਹਾਗਣੀ ਜਿਨ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਰਿ ਹਾਰੁ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: saavan tinaa suhaaganee jin raam naam ur haar ||6||
lines.translation: Saawan is delightful for those happy soul-brides whose hearts are adorned with the Necklace of the Lord's Name. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਾਦੁਇ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਣੀਆ ਦੂਜੈ ਲਗਾ ਹੇਤੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhaadui bharam bhulaaneeaa doojai lagaa het ||
lines.translation: In the month of Bhaadon, she is deluded by doubt, because of her attachment to duality.

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਸੀਗਾਰ ਬਣਾਇਆ ਕਾਰਜਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੇਤੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: lakh seegaar banaaiaa kaaraj naahee ket ||
lines.translation: She may wear thousands of ornaments, but they are of no use at all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਦਿਨਿ ਦੇਹ ਬਿਨਸਸੀ ਤਿਤੁ ਵੇਲੈ ਕਹਸਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਤੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jit din deh binasasee tit velai kahasan pret ||
lines.translation: On that day when the body perishes-at that time, she becomes a ghost.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਕੜਿ ਚਲਾਇਨਿ ਦੂਤ ਜਮ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਦੇਨੀ ਭੇਤੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: pakaR chalaain doot jam kisai na denee bhet ||
lines.translation: The Messenger of Death seizes and holds her, and does not tell anyone his secret.

lines.gurmukhi: ਛਡਿ ਖੜੋਤੇ ਖਿਨੈ ਮਾਹਿ ਜਿਨ ਸਿਉ ਲਗਾ ਹੇਤੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: chhad khaRote khinai maahi jin siu lagaa het ||
lines.translation: And her loved ones-in an instant, they move on, leaving her all alone.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਥ ਮਰੋੜੈ ਤਨੁ ਕਪੇ ਸਿਆਹਹੁ ਹੋਆ ਸੇਤੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: hath maroRai tan kape siaahahu hoaa set ||
lines.translation: She wrings her hands, her body writhes in pain, and she turns from black to white.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇਹਾ ਬੀਜੈ ਸੋ ਲੁਣੈ ਕਰਮਾ ਸੰਦੜਾ ਖੇਤੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jehaa beejai so lunai karamaa sa(n)daRaa khet ||
lines.translation: As she has planted, so does she harvest; such is the field of karma.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਚਰਣ ਬੋਹਿਥ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੇਤੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak prabh saranaagatee charan bohith prabh det ||
lines.translation: Nanak seeks God's Sanctuary; God has given him the Boat of His Feet.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਭਾਦੁਇ ਨਰਕਿ ਨ ਪਾਈਅਹਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਰਖਣ ਵਾਲਾ ਹੇਤੁ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: se bhaadui narak na paaeeahi gur rakhan vaalaa het ||7||
lines.translation: Those who love the Guru, the Protector and Savior, in Bhaadon, shall not be thrown down into hell. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਸੁਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਉਮਾਹੜਾ ਕਿਉ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: asun prem umaahaRaa kiu mileeai har jaai ||
lines.translation: In the month of Assu, my love for the Lord overwhelms me. How can I go and meet the Lord?
